# fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engines_v1 (Data Source)

List every managed FKE cluster in a VPC, v1 and v2 alike.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engines_v1" "example" {
  vpc_id = "your_vpc_id"
}

# Names of all clusters in the VPC
output "cluster_names" {
  value = [for cluster in data.fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engines_v1.example.clusters : cluster.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC whose clusters are listed.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (List of Object) The managed FKE clusters in the VPC. Attribute names follow the `fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1` resource. Each cluster has:
  - `id`: the full name of the cluster, e.g. `my-cluster-ab12cd34`, the same value as the resource's `id`.
  - `cluster_name`: the full name of the cluster, the same as `id`, as in the `fptcloud_managed_kubernetes_engine_v1` data source, which takes it as `cluster_name`.
  - `k8s_version`: Kubernetes version.
  - `purpose`: `public`, `private` or `firewall`.
  - `is_running`: `false` when the cluster is hibernated.
  - `cluster_endpoint_access`: access to the Kubernetes API server: `type` (`public`, `private` or `mixed`) and the allowed CIDR blocks in `allow_cidr`.
  - `network_type`: network plugin, e.g. `calico` or `cilium`.
  - `node_network`, `node_prefix`: node network address and prefix.
  - `pod_network`, `pod_prefix`: pod network address and prefix.
  - `service_network`, `service_prefix`: service network address and prefix.
  - `k8s_max_pod`: max pods per node.
  - `created_at`: creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
  - `tags`: the tag IDs of the cluster.
  - `pools`: the worker pools, each with `name`, `worker_type` (flavor ID), `machine_type` (flavor name, e.g. `2C4G`), `vgpu_id` (empty for a pool without GPU), `storage_profile`, `worker_disk_size` (GB), `scale_min`, `scale_max`, `worker_base` and `is_enable_auto_repair`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
